key_safety.text: Favorable safety profile. Most common adverse reactions in the pooled Trials 03 and 04 safety population (N=2,570 nirsevimab vs N=1,284 placebo) were rash (0.9% vs 0.6%) and injection site reactions (0.3% vs 0%). Key safety concerns are hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis and serious skin reactions (not reported in clinical trials).
